title: Rename a Go function used across multiple call sites
description: A Go package has a poorly-named function `CalcResult` used in 3 places across 2 source files. Rename it to `ComputeScore` everywhere. Agent must use grep/search to find all call sites then edit all files. All tests must remain green.

task_spec.prompt:
The test file expects a function named `ComputeScore` but the implementation defines it as `CalcResult`. Rename `CalcResult` to `ComputeScore` everywhere it appears in score.go and report.go, so all tests pass.

Use search tools to find all occurrences first, then apply the renames. Run `go test ./...` to verify.
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` to check the current state. Walk me through what bugs you found and fixed. If any tests are still failing, show me the errors and fix them.
Final verification: run `go test ./...` and confirm a completely clean build. Every test must pass — if any are still red, fix them now.
